interpretation.ADEQUATE_FOR_DETECTING_FPR_0.10: N=20 has ≥80% power to detect FPR=0.10 (a good matcher with 10% accidental match rate). The experiment can confidently distinguish a good matcher from random.
interpretation.ADEQUATE_FOR_DETECTING_FPR_0.25: N=20 has ≥80% power to detect FPR=0.25 but NOT FPR=0.10. The experiment can distinguish a poor matcher from random but cannot confidently verify a good matcher.
interpretation.EXPLORATORY_LOW_POWERED: N=20 has <80% power even at FPR=0.25. The experiment is exploratory and cannot make confident claims about discrimination ability.

claim_limitation: Protocol A tests LEXICAL separability only. It does NOT test discovery capability, cross-domain relationship discrimination, or engine competence. TPR_true = 1.0 by construction.
